title.source: 龜甲萬：倒出1滴，空氣為何不能進錯地方？｜品牌故事
title.text: Kikkoman: One Drop Out—Why Does It Matter Where Air Gets In? | Brand Stories

description.source:
從1961可再填的150mL玻璃桌上瓶，走到2011的200mL內袋密封瓶，另讀公開文件中500mL軟膜原型的靜置與落下試驗，再看現行450mL PET瓶用到最後的力道、關蓋與拆開密封後的保存取捨。原型試驗與上市瓶型分開，沒有把原型當成量產款履歷。設計者本人回述、公司原公告、博物館標籤、後期專利原件和完整官方FAQ，分清不同年代和瓶型。後期閥門專利不當早年玻璃瓶原設計；匿名插圖是概念示意，非每款量產剖面。

description.text:
From the refillable 150mL glass tabletop bottle of 1961 to the 200mL sealed bottle with an inner pouch of 2011, we also examine the standing and drop tests of a 500mL soft-film prototype in publicly available documents. Then we look at squeezing force near the end of a current 450mL PET bottle, closing its cap, and the storage tradeoff after breaking the seal. The prototype tests are kept separate from the marketed bottle models; the prototype is not presented as the production model's history. The designer's own recollections, original company announcements, museum labels, later original patents, and complete official FAQs distinguish different eras and bottle models. The later valve patent is not treated as the original design of the earlier glass bottle. Generic illustrations are conceptual diagrams, not cross-sections of every production model.

lines.source: 你只想添一滴醬油，卻得先搬動一點八公升的大瓶。
lines.text: You only want to add one drop of soy sauce, but first you have to lift a big 1.8-liter bottle.

lines.source: 榮久庵憲司回憶，一九五八年接到委託時，許多家庭把醬油大瓶放在水槽下。
lines.text: Kenji Ekuan recalled that when he received the commission in 1958, many households kept their large soy sauce bottles under the sink.

lines.source: 玻璃小瓶出現以前，你先把大瓶醬油倒進小陶壺，才把它端上餐桌。
lines.text: Before the small glass bottle arrived, you poured soy sauce from the big bottle into a small ceramic pot, then brought it to the table.

lines.source: 嘴尖那一點褐色，會乖乖停住嗎？
lines.text: Will that little brown drop at the tip of the spout stay put?

lines.source: 但後來，連進入瓶裡的空氣，都成了難題。
lines.text: But later, even the air entering the bottle became a problem.

lines.source: 最後一點倒不出來時，整座瓶蓋還藏著一個選擇。
lines.text: When the last little bit won't pour out, the cap itself still gives you a choice.

lines.source: 我想跟著龜甲萬的這一滴，追過六十多年的瓶子改動。
lines.text: I want to follow this drop of Kikkoman soy sauce through more than sixty years of changes to the bottle.

lines.source: 你手裡的瓶子，究竟要讓什麼出去，才能把想留的東西留住？
lines.text: What does the bottle in your hand need to let out, so it can keep in what you want to preserve?

lines.source: 龜甲萬後來的說法，是要做一個買回來便能直接放上桌的小容器。
lines.text: Kikkoman later explained that the aim was a small container you could put straight on the table after buying it.

lines.source: 它不只得裝得下醬油，還要像杯盤一樣，成為吃飯時用的器具。
lines.text: It had to do more than hold soy sauce. Like cups and plates, it had to become something you used at mealtimes.

lines.source: 商品瓶要走到餐具旁邊，它該長成什麼樣子？
lines.text: What should a retail bottle look like if it is going to sit beside the tableware?

lines.source: 題目相當開放：怎麼讓一種存在幾百年的醬油，看起來有新的樣子？
lines.text: The brief was wide open: how could soy sauce, which had been around for hundreds of years, be given a new look?

lines.source: 他說，自己曾想過像水龍頭一樣，轉開就能流出醬油。
lines.text: He said he had considered something like a faucet: turn it on, and soy sauce would flow out.

lines.source: 也想過改變醬油的黑色。這些是構想，最後該交到手裡的又是什麼？
lines.text: He had even considered changing soy sauce's black color. These were ideas, but what should finally go into the user's hands?

lines.source: 但最後要交到使用者手上的，仍是一個能拿、能倒、能放回桌面的瓶子。
lines.text: In the end, though, users still needed a bottle they could pick up, pour from, and put back on the table.

lines.source: 我想知道，你把它拿起來時，手要抓哪裡？放下時，又靠哪裡站住？
lines.text: I want to know: when you pick it up, where do you grip it? And when you put it down, what keeps it standing?

lines.source: 榮久庵說，他把頸部做細，瓶身則往下逐漸變得寬而穩。
lines.text: Ekuan said he made the neck narrow, with a body that gradually grew wider and steadier toward the bottom.

lines.source: 他的想像，是手指握住頸部，手的線條也能好看。
lines.text: He pictured fingers holding the neck, with the lines of the hand looking graceful too.

lines.source: 這是設計者對握持的意圖，不是每個人的手都會擺成同一個姿勢。
lines.text: That was the designer's intention for the grip. It doesn't mean everyone's hand would take the same position.

lines.source: 到了一九六一年，公司推出一百五十毫升的玻璃桌上瓶。
lines.text: In 1961, the company launched a 150-milliliter glass tabletop bottle.

lines.source: 透明瓶身還讓人看見醬油餘量，不必先打開蓋子猜。
lines.text: The clear body also let you see how much soy sauce was left, without opening the cap and guessing.

lines.source: 它在桌上站好了，手也找到了握的位置，可手一收，嘴尖怎麼辦？
lines.text: It stands on the table, and your hand has found a place to grip. But when you pull your hand back, what happens at the spout?

lines.source: 榮久庵回述這個難題時，先拿茶壺的嘴作比較。
lines.text: When Ekuan recalled this problem, he began by comparing it with a teapot's spout.

lines.source: 他說，像茶壺那樣讓下緣伸出去，醬油仍會往下滴。
lines.text: He said that if the lower lip stuck out, as on a teapot, soy sauce would still drip down.

lines.source: 於是他把上下緣的關係反過來，讓上緣比較突出。
lines.text: So he reversed the relationship between the two lips, making the upper one stick out farther.

lines.source: 開場你收回手時在意的那一滴，就卡在這個小小的末端。
lines.text: That drop you worried about when pulling your hand back at the start comes down to this tiny tip.

lines.source: 我最喜歡這裡，因為改動看來很小，管的卻是你每次倒完的收手。
lines.text: This is my favorite part: the change looks small, but it shapes how you pull your hand back every time you finish pouring.

lines.source: 但是瓶嘴只求不滴，就夠了嗎？
lines.text: But is stopping drips all a spout needs to do?

lines.source: 紐約現代美術館後來的展覽標籤說，他做過接近一百個模型。
lines.text: A later exhibition label at New York's Museum of Modern Art said he had made nearly a hundred models.

lines.source: 館方把難題寫成兩件事：防止滴液，還有控制流量。
lines.text: The museum described two challenges: preventing drips and controlling the flow.

lines.source: 榮久庵自己回憶，這個設計前後做了三年，才把樣子與使用合在一起。
lines.text: Ekuan himself recalled spending three years on the design before bringing its appearance and use together.

lines.source: 它將末端的內傾形狀，和減少醬油留積在嘴尖的結果連起來。
lines.text: The label links the tip's inward slope with less soy sauce collecting at the end of the spout.

lines.source: 可注嘴這麼小，瓶裡用完時，醬油該從哪裡再裝進去？
lines.text: But with a spout this small, where do you put more soy sauce in when the bottle is empty?

lines.source: 再填走的不是注嘴。整個紅蓋拿下，露出的才是補充口。
lines.text: You don't refill it through the spout. Remove the entire red cap, and the refill opening appears.

lines.source: GK刊物說，這個補充口比開場那種大瓶的瓶口還稍寬，方便再填。
lines.text: A GK publication says this opening is even slightly wider than the mouth of the big bottle from the start, making refilling easier.

lines.source: 你倒給盤子時，要的是小而俐落的出口；補進瓶子時，手卻需要較寬的入口。
lines.text: When you pour onto a plate, you want a small outlet with a clean cutoff; when you refill the bottle, your hand needs a wider opening.

lines.source: 同一個蓋子，拿起來再填時，手又會碰到哪裡？
lines.text: And when you lift that same cap to refill the bottle, where does your hand touch it?

lines.source: 到二〇〇七年度，歐洲子公司KFE的報告，還記下一個蓋子的改動。
lines.text: A fiscal 2007 report from the European subsidiary KFE also records a change to the cap.

lines.source: 蓋上的凸起被改成圓角，目的是避免開蓋、再填時傷到手。
lines.text: The raised parts on the cap were given rounded corners, to avoid hurting hands when opening it and refilling the bottle.

lines.source: 那瓶身透明，裡頭的東西就一定能一直保持剛開的樣子嗎？
lines.text: But does a clear bottle mean what's inside can always stay just as it was when first opened?

lines.source: 這讓我想問：你要讓醬油出去，又不讓空氣進去，原來的瓶子該怎麼變？
lines.text: That makes me wonder: if you want soy sauce to get out and air to stay out, how does the original bottle need to change?

lines.source: 在二〇一〇年，龜甲萬先推出裝五百毫升的密封軟袋。
lines.text: In 2010, Kikkoman first launched a sealed flexible pouch holding 500 milliliters.

lines.source: 你拿起這款生醬油，倒完放回桌上，剩下的還得等下一次取用。
lines.text: You pick up this unpasteurized soy sauce, pour some, and put it back on the table. What's left has to wait until next time.

lines.source: 龜甲萬的產品開發人員恩田友貴後來解釋，這款醬油省去火入加熱，改用特殊過濾去除微生物。
lines.text: Kikkoman product developer Onda (恩田友貴) later explained that this soy sauce skips heat pasteurization and uses special filtration to remove microorganisms instead.

lines.source: 但它的色澤和香氣一碰到空氣，仍會改變。
lines.text: But its color and aroma still change when it comes into contact with air.

lines.source: 照二〇一一年的公告，龜甲萬已經研究密封容器超過十年。
lines.text: According to the 2011 announcement, Kikkoman had already spent more than ten years researching sealed containers.

lines.source: 可是醬油少了之後，這個軟袋還能讓你放心放手嗎？
lines.text: But once there is less soy sauce inside, can you still let go of that flexible pouch with confidence?

lines.source: 恩田後來回憶，軟袋剩少時不容易自己站住，也有人想單手開蓋。
lines.text: Onda later recalled that a nearly empty pouch struggled to stand on its own, and some people wanted to open the cap with one hand.

lines.source: 想像你正在料理，一手還忙著拿東西，另一手要放開袋子。
lines.text: Imagine you're cooking, with one hand still holding something, while the other needs to let go of the pouch.

lines.source: 如果它得靠手一直扶著，少掉的就不只是一點重量。
lines.text: If you have to keep holding it up, you're losing more than just a little weight.

lines.source: 那能不能讓外形站住，裡面卻仍保留隔絕空氣的安排？
lines.text: Could the outside stand on its own while the inside kept air away from the soy sauce?

lines.source: 公司改與容器廠來回開發瓶型，恩田說，這一段十個月就商品化。
lines.text: The company turned to developing a bottle with a container manufacturer, going back and forth. Onda said this phase reached the market in ten months.

lines.source: 二〇一一年七月的公告，預告新兩百毫升瓶要在八月十日推出。
lines.text: An announcement in July 2011 said the new 200-milliliter bottle would launch on August 10.

lines.source: 第一款的外形沿著舊紅蓋桌上瓶的線索，手裡卻換成可擠壓的新瓶。
lines.text: The first version took its shape from the old red-capped tabletop bottle, but what you held was a new bottle you could squeeze.

lines.source: 瓶蓋又要怎麼回應，料理時那隻騰不出的手？
lines.text: And how would the cap respond to that hand you can't spare while cooking?

lines.source: 公司把一按便能開的蓋子，列為這個新瓶的功能。
lines.text: The company listed a cap that opens with one push as a feature of this new bottle.

lines.source: 公司也把按壓控量，列成這個新瓶的功能。
lines.text: It also listed control of the amount dispensed by squeezing as a feature of this new bottle.

lines.source: 當年的這款新瓶，還以開栓後常溫維持鮮度九十天，作為公司的功能主張。
lines.text: That year's new bottle was also said to keep soy sauce fresh for ninety days at room temperature after opening, a feature claimed by the company.

lines.source: 可是當你的手放鬆，瓶子還得恢復可繼續使用的樣子。
lines.text: But when you relax your hand, the bottle still has to recover its shape so you can keep using it.

lines.source: 空氣究竟該進哪裡，才不會把保鮮的工作一起拆掉？
lines.text: Where exactly should the air go, so it doesn't undo the work of keeping the soy sauce fresh?

lines.source: 這一代新瓶，在外瓶裡，另外放了一個裝醬油的內袋。
lines.text: This generation of bottle had an inner pouch for the soy sauce, placed inside an outer bottle.

lines.source: 醬油往外倒，內袋隨著內容減少縮小。
lines.text: As soy sauce pours out, the inner pouch shrinks as its contents decrease.

lines.source: 公告說，出去多少醬油，便有相當量的空氣進入外瓶和內袋之間。
lines.text: The announcement says that for the amount of soy sauce that leaves, a corresponding amount of air enters the space between the outer bottle and the inner pouch.

lines.source: 那瓶蓋怎樣分辨，該讓出去的是液體，還是該讓回來的是空氣？
lines.text: So how does the cap distinguish between liquid that needs to go out and air that needs to come back in?

lines.source: 公告稱它採雙逆止閥的蓋子，讓醬油通過，卻不讓空氣進入醬油內袋。
lines.text: The announcement describes a cap with two check valves, letting soy sauce through while keeping air out of the soy sauce pouch.

lines.source: 我更想看，你已經鬆手了，注嘴裡剩下的那一點，又會去哪裡？
lines.text: What I want to see even more is this: once you have let go, where does that little bit left in the spout go?

lines.source: 後來的官方教材，把這款密封桌上瓶，連到一份日本專利。
lines.text: Later official educational materials linked this sealed tabletop bottle to a Japanese patent.

lines.source: 原件在二〇一五年登錄，描述的是一套特定的容器與液閥結構。
lines.text: Granted in 2015, the original document describes a particular container and liquid-valve structure.

lines.source: 文件要處理的，是液體沒有回到內器、卻留在出口附近而可能漏出的情況。
lines.text: The document addresses liquid that does not return to the inner container, but remains near the outlet and could leak.

lines.source: 只把通往內袋的路關住，嘴口裡的殘液就會自己消失嗎？
lines.text: If you only close the route to the inner pouch, will the liquid left in the spout disappear by itself?

lines.source: 按這個方案，手擠壓時，內部壓力會推動有彈性的液閥。
lines.text: In this design, when you squeeze, pressure inside pushes an elastic liquid valve.

lines.source: 閥件沿著通道的方向移動，開出讓內容物流過的路。
lines.text: The valve moves along the passage, opening a route for the contents to flow through.

lines.source: 閥件移多遠，也另有一個限制位移的部位管著。
lines.text: A separate part limits how far the valve can move.

lines.source: 你一鬆手，壓力減弱，閥件便開始往內側回復。
lines.text: When you let go, the pressure drops and the valve starts returning inward.

lines.source: 它先把連通孔關住，之後繼續回移，讓蓋內一處空間變大。
lines.text: First it closes the connecting hole, then keeps moving back, enlarging a space inside the cap.

lines.source: 這一點移動，要怎麼管到嘴尖？
lines.text: How can that small movement affect the tip of the spout?

lines.source: 文件說，擴大的空間能把嘴端殘液拉進蓋內，這個位置和裝醬油的內袋分開。
lines.text: The document says the expanding space can draw liquid left at the tip into the cap, a location separate from the inner pouch holding the soy sauce.

lines.source: 外界空氣，此時能被吸進吐出口。
lines.text: Outside air can now be drawn into the discharge opening.

lines.source: 專利也把空氣閥與外側進氣通道列進構造，讓進氣和液閥各有自己的工作。
lines.text: The patent also includes an air valve and an outer air-intake passage in the structure, giving the incoming air and the liquid valve their own jobs.

lines.source: 那手沒有擠瓶子、外蓋已關上時，液閥還需要管嗎？
lines.text: And when you aren't squeezing the bottle and the outer cap is closed, does the liquid valve still need to be controlled?

lines.source: 文件另有含外蓋的構造，外蓋內側的密封部，也負責抑制液閥的彈性移動。
lines.text: The document also describes a structure with an outer cap. A sealing part inside that cap also helps restrain the liquid valve's elastic movement.

lines.source: 可你隔幾天再拿起容器，閥擋住了空氣，就一定還倒得出來嗎？
lines.text: But when you pick the container up again a few days later, does keeping air out mean it will still pour?

lines.source: 另一份公開專利裡，申請人記錄了五百毫升軟膜原型的試製和試驗。
lines.text: In another publicly available patent, the applicant recorded the making and testing of a 500-milliliter soft-film prototype.

lines.source: 他們先把橡膠小蓋與本體一體成形，再從內側加壓，把圓弧部分切開。
lines.text: They first molded a small rubber flap and its body as one piece, then applied pressure from inside and cut along the curved section.

lines.source: 直線那一小段沒有切斷，成為小蓋翻動的鉸接處。
lines.text: The short straight section was left uncut, forming a hinge for the flap.

lines.source: 但一受撞擊，這扇小門會只往外翻，還是連整片都陷進去？
lines.text: But if it takes an impact, will this little door just swing outward, or will the whole flap be pushed inside?

lines.source: 文件先指出，小蓋可能被衝擊擠進筒內，連逆止與出液都受影響。
lines.text: The document first notes that an impact could force the flap into the tube, affecting both the check-valve function and liquid flow.

lines.source: 它在小蓋側面加上凸部，讓凸部抵住開口邊緣，抑制往裡陷。
lines.text: It adds a raised feature on the side of the flap, which catches against the opening's edge to help stop it being pushed inward.

lines.source: 做好的閥裝進軟膜容器，再灌入醬油，接著就要等下一次取用。
lines.text: The finished valve goes into the soft-film container, which is then filled with soy sauce. Next comes the wait until it is used again.

lines.source: 留在常溫幾個時段後，你想要的兩件事，還會一起成立嗎？
lines.text: After it has stood at room temperature for different lengths of time, will both things you want still hold true?

lines.source: 每個時間條件都用五個樣品，先以目視判斷，有沒有空氣混進容器。
lines.text: Five samples were used for each time condition. First, they checked visually for air entering the container.

lines.source: 再把容器傾到約四十五度，看醬油能不能順利流出。
lines.text: Then they tilted the container to about forty-five degrees, to see whether the soy sauce flowed out smoothly.

lines.source: 前兩天的幾個觀察點，全都未見空氣混入，出液也良好；等到五天呢？
lines.text: At all the observation points in the first two days, no air entry was seen and the flow was good. What about five days?

lines.source: 一百二十小時後，仍未看見空氣混入；但容器傾斜，醬油不再自然流出。
lines.text: After 120 hours, there was still no observed air entry; but when the container was tilted, soy sauce no longer flowed out naturally.

lines.source: 文件記下，閥蓋與開口邊緣接觸的地方，有少量醬油固化。
lines.text: The document records a small amount of soy sauce solidifying where the valve flap touched the edge of the opening.

lines.source: 那若容器掉下去，外面沒有漏出醬油，小蓋就一定還在原位嗎？
lines.text: And if the container falls without soy sauce leaking outside, does that mean the flap is still in place?

lines.source: 另一組落下試驗，不裝外蓋時，讓樣品底朝下，自然落下一次。
lines.text: In a separate set of drop tests, samples without the outer cap were allowed to fall freely once, bottom first.

lines.source: 裝了外蓋，程序改成先底朝下落一次，再讓側面朝下落一次。
lines.text: With the outer cap fitted, the procedure changed to one drop bottom first, then one drop side first.

lines.source: 每個條件各用五個樣品，落下後，再看空氣與出液這兩項結果。
lines.text: Five samples were used for each condition. After the drops, they again checked air entry and liquid flow.

lines.source: 表列一百四十公分那組，兩項觀察還都正常；再抬高呢？
lines.text: In the group listed at 140 centimeters, both observations were still normal. What if it fell from higher up?

lines.source: 一百六十公分那組，小蓋陷進筒內，空氣混入，醬油也不能自然倒出。
lines.text: In the 160-centimeter group, the flap was pushed into the tube, air entered, and soy sauce could no longer be poured out naturally.

lines.source: 可是直到這組高度的各次試驗，文件都沒有觀察到內容物漏到外面。
lines.text: Yet in all the tests up to and including that height, the document reports no observed leakage of the contents to the outside.

lines.source: 回到上市瓶型，二〇一八年，公司在四百五十毫升的新瓶，把主要材料從PE換成PET。
lines.text: Returning to bottles sold on the market, in 2018, the company changed the main material from PE to PET in a new 450-milliliter bottle.

lines.source: 你拿起透明的密封瓶，裡面的內袋，一眼就看得出來嗎？
lines.text: When you pick up the clear sealed bottle, can you spot the inner pouch at a glance?

lines.source: 約用到半瓶，兩層之間的差別才比較看得出來。
lines.text: The difference between the two layers becomes easier to see once about half the bottle has been used.

lines.source: 如果連袋內都看見了氣層，難道又是外面漏進去了？
lines.text: If you can see a layer of gas even inside the pouch, has air leaked in from outside again?

lines.source: 目前另一則FAQ解釋，內袋還封入了氮氣，來幫助醬油推出。
lines.text: Another current FAQ explains that nitrogen is also sealed inside the inner pouch to help push the soy sauce out.

lines.source: 公司說，內袋裡的氮氣不會讓醬油氧化。
lines.text: The company says the nitrogen in the inner pouch does not oxidize the soy sauce.

lines.source: 這則FAQ還說，瓶子傾斜時，氮氣移動可能帶來小小振動，傳到手上。
lines.text: The FAQ also says that when the bottle is tilted, moving nitrogen may cause a slight vibration that you can feel in your hand.

lines.source: 可是同樣的一隻手，用到後來，為什麼又覺得比較難擠？
lines.text: But with the same hand, why does it start to feel harder to squeeze as you use more of it?

lines.source: 另一則FAQ說，袋子越縮小，手的力就逐漸隔著層間空氣，間接去壓內袋。
lines.text: Another FAQ says that as the pouch gets smaller, your hand's force increasingly presses it indirectly, through the air between the layers.

lines.source: 傳力的方式跟著改變，所以公司要使用者依剩量調整按壓的力道。
lines.text: The way force is transmitted changes, so the company tells users to adjust how hard they press according to how much is left.

lines.source: 手放開之後，瓶蓋能不能立刻按回去？
lines.text: Once you let go, can you press the cap shut right away?

lines.source: 現行這款的官方說明，是用完先直立放幾秒，再關蓋。
lines.text: The official instructions for this current bottle say to leave it upright for a few seconds after use, then close the cap.

lines.source: 嘴內的醬油較容易回到瓶內，關蓋時被擠出的量就能減少。
lines.text: That makes it easier for soy sauce in the spout to return to the bottle, reducing the amount squeezed out when the cap closes.

lines.source: 如果你放開手，瓶身卻還凹著，問題只在手裡的力道嗎？
lines.text: If you let go but the bottle stays dented, is the force of your hand the only issue?

lines.source: 嘴邊的醬油若固化、堵住空氣閥，瓶身就可能凹著回不來。
lines.text: If soy sauce around the spout solidifies and blocks the air valve, the bottle may stay dented instead of springing back.

lines.source: 公司說，冷藏時也可能一開蓋就噴出，或冒泡溢出；其他因素也可能帶來這些情況。
lines.text: The company says refrigerated bottles may also spurt as soon as the cap opens, or bubble over; other factors can cause these situations too.

lines.source: 對嘴邊的汙損，原廠給的動作是柔軟布沾水、用力擰乾，再擦拭瓶嘴。
lines.text: For a dirty spout, the manufacturer says to wet a soft cloth, wring it out firmly, and then wipe the spout.

lines.source: 密封正常時，現行這款瓶的保鮮目安，是開栓後常溫一百二十天。
lines.text: With the seal working normally, the freshness guideline for this current bottle is 120 days at room temperature after opening.

lines.source: 部分產品另有例外。
lines.text: There are exceptions for some products.

lines.source: 我還想知道，你要的最後一點留在裡面時，還有沒有別的拿法？
lines.text: I also want to know: when that last bit you want is still inside, is there another way to get it out?

lines.source: 剩很少時，可以從上方看，往右轉下整座蓋子，取出餘量。
lines.text: When very little is left, you can remove the entire cap by turning it to the right as seen from above, and get the remainder out.

lines.source: 但這個動作也會切斷密封；取下以後，官方要求改放冰箱。
lines.text: But that also breaks the seal. Once the cap is removed, the official instructions require refrigeration instead.

lines.source: 開場你想留下的那一滴，最後連著的，是瓶子允許你開哪一個口、又得重新守哪一道界線。
lines.text: That drop you wanted to keep at the start is ultimately tied to which opening the bottle lets you open, and which boundary you then need to protect again.

lines.source: 如果是你，會為了取出最後一點而拆開密封、改放冰箱，還是讓它停在那裡？留言告訴我。
lines.text: What would you do: break the seal to get the last bit out and move it to the fridge, or leave it there? Tell me in the comments.

lines.source: 訂閱品牌故事，我們繼續看日用品怎麼把看不見的取捨，放進你的每一個動作。
lines.text: Subscribe to Brand Stories. We'll keep looking at how everyday objects put invisible tradeoffs into your every move.
